title: Icon vật phẩm Sobi Garden: 5 hạt, 5 nông sản, thức ăn cao cấp, phân bón
decisions: Seeds reuse the paper seed-packet shape of the Cloud seeds (cloud-02-items) so every seed in the game reads the same. Premium feed is a burlap sack like the Farm food sack (style_reference_environment row 3) but with a richer corn-and-carrot mix and a small gold ribbon, so it is not mistaken for the normal feed; fertilizer is a small brown sack of dark compost with a green sprout on it.

sheets.name: S
sheets.title: 5 gói hạt + phân bón

hints.what: the seed packet (a small paper envelope with a plant picture printed on it)

sheets.notes: The five seed packets are the same paper seed packet, slightly tilted, top edge folded; each shows a small picture of its crop and has its own soft packet colour. No writing on the packets.

cells.desc: light green packet with a green grass tuft
wheat-gold packet with two golden wheat ears
sunny yellow packet with a golden corn cob
warm tan packet with a round potato and a leaf
soft orange packet with a carrot and its green top
Fertilizer: a small tied brown burlap sack, open at the top, full of dark crumbly compost, a tiny green sprout poking out of the compost

sheets.name: P
sheets.title: 5 nông sản + thức ăn cao cấp

hints.what: the burlap feed sack full of corn

sheets.notes: Freshly harvested produce, lying slightly diagonal, no basket or crate.

cells.desc: Forage Grass: a small bundle of fresh green grass tied with a straw band
Wheat: a small sheaf of three golden wheat stalks tied with twine
Corn: one plump corn cob with golden kernels, green husk peeled back
Potato: two round tan potatoes with small dark spots, one in front of the other
Carrot: two bright orange carrots with feathery green tops, crossed
Premium Pig Feed: a burlap sack tied with a small golden ribbon, open at the top, overflowing with golden corn kernels mixed with orange carrot pieces, a little pig-face emblem on the sack
